stories.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
stories.body: The five-year old Gaza girl initially survived the attack and pleaded for help but her body was recovered later with those of six of her relatives.

stories.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
stories.body: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

stories.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
stories.body: Israeli plans to build on the area east of Jerusalem - which would divide the occupied West Bank in two - have long been internationally condemned.

stories.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
stories.body: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

stories.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
stories.body: The man is alleged to have been one of the scuba divers who planted explosives on the pipelines in 2022.

stories.title: Ecuador intelligence chief and five Americans killed in Kenya helicopter crash
stories.body: Michele Sensi-Contugi, and his wife Stephany Hollihan among the seven people killed in the crash.

stories.title: Canada and US say they are finalising a trade deal, but details remain murky
stories.body: Prime Minister Carney hailed "significant progress" in trade talks as the two countries seek to hammer out final details ahead of a new weekend tariff deadline.

stories.title: Head-on collision between bus and lorry in Brazil kills more than 20
stories.body: It is not yet clear what caused the two vehicles to crash into each other in the early hours of Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Two detained after French influencer's scorched body found in vineyard
stories.body: Sonia Bellina's body was "abandoned" after "a murder of rare savagery", the family's lawyer says.

stories.title: 81-year-old confesses to German cold case murder of US tourist in 1994
stories.body: Amy Lopez from Texas was last seen alive in September 1994 while on a visit to a fortress in Koblenz.

stories.title: 'I was born in South Africa', says beauty queen facing legal bid to deport her
stories.body: Chidimma Adetshina is challenging efforts to have her deported from South Africa, which she says is her home.

stories.title: Trump administration can target Ethiopians for deportation
stories.body: Judge Brian Murphy cleared the way for the Trump administration to cancel Temporary Protected Status for Ethiopians living in the US.

stories.title: Watch: SpaceX rocket spotted off Christmas Island coast
stories.body: A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July, and crashed into the Indian Ocean, made an unexpected appearance off Christmas Island.

stories.title: Angélique Kidjo becomes first African musician with Hollywood Walk of Fame star
stories.body: Without Africans, no music is possible on this planet, says the 66-year-old musical icon from Benin.

stories.title: Retail giant Target receives $1bn boost from tariff refunds
stories.body: The US chain said it received a $994 million pre-tax reimbursement, which resulted in its second quarter operating income rising to $2.6bn.

stories.title: Liberia agrees to accept 1,200 foreign deportees from the US
stories.body: Liberia says the deal is a "humanitarian arrangement" and is receiving no compensation.

stories.title: US charges 17 Iranians over 'massive' cyber theft campaign
stories.body: Many of the alleged cyber attacks were carried out for the Iranian government, the Department of Justice says.

stories.title: Who is Natalie Harp, Trump's right-hand woman?
stories.body: One of Trump's longest serving and most loyal aides, Harp was thrust again into the spotlight when Democrat Jon Ossoff noted her closeness to the president.

stories.title: Trial of mum accused of killing her three children puts postpartum psychosis on the map
stories.body: Postpartum psychosis is a psychiatric emergency that can involve mania, depression, hallucinations and delusions.

stories.title: French civil servant drugged us to make us urinate on ourselves, say accusers
stories.body: More than 200 women accuse Christian Nègre of drugging them to make them urinate - two share their stories.

Contested signals include South Korea shortening war games with the US at Washington’s request. While the direction is positive, the contest score reflects underlying geopolitical tensions. This decision, framed as stability-seeking and governance-oriented, hints at recalibrations in US-South Korea military cooperation, potentially influenced by broader strategic priorities in the Indo-Pacific. The contestedness underscores the fragility of such adjustments in a region marked by competing interests.

Longer-term, these signals suggest a cautious trajectory across trade, governance, and cultural representation. The trade deal, if finalized, could reshape North American economic frameworks, while Target’s refund highlights the ongoing interplay between corporate strategy and trade policy. South Korea’s decision reflects evolving military alignments, with implications for regional stability.
